1946年（昭和21年）、終戦直後の姫路に創業した町中華食堂。 食糧難の時代、調.en: A neighbourhood Chinese diner founded in 1946 (Showa 21) in Himeji just after the war. In a time of food shortage, using scraps such as pork fat and cabbage cores for staff meals is said to be the origin of its shumai, which was later improved for customers and became the signature dish. For over 70 years, with Showa-era interiors and tableware almost unchanged, it has been loved by generations of Himeji people. It is now in Nishi-Nikaimachi.

1968年兵庫県生まれ。高校・大学時代から飲食業に携わり、ホテル勤務ではプロ野球.en: Born in Hyogo in 1968. Worked in food service from high school and university; at a hotel, cooked meals for professional baseball players. Went independent from a conviction that "food made in advance can't move people", and believes in live cooking in front of guests. Omotenashi Kikou was listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide. Now also chairs the Hyogo Prefecture Specialty Products Promotion Association.

1970年創業、鳥羽駅から約300m・約58席の昭和レトロな喫茶＆洋食店。ボリュ.en: Founded in 1970, a Shōwa-retro coffee shop and Western-style diner of about 58 seats, about 300 m from Toba Station. Famous for the hearty 'bomb set meal' and a huge plate of chicken (about 16 pieces) hiding spaghetti underneath. The coffee is made by a master who has won the national Coffee Masters championship, and from the window you can see trains and the Shimakaze.

2017年3月1日、姫路のおみぞ筋商店街に開店（カフェ・ケーキ店「テンヤ」跡地を.en: Opened on 1 March 2017 in Himeji's Omizo-suji shopping arcade (renovating the former café and cake shop "Tenya"). The owner began training in soba at 18, including at a soba shop in Izushi, and went independent after about 20 years. It opened with the wish to "be a local shop loved by office workers and families alike".

2017年に訪れた東京餃子通信の記者は、綺麗な焼き色の餃子を「見た目と異なり上品.en: A Tokyo Gyoza Tsushin reporter who visited in 2017 described the nicely browned gyoza as having "a refined flavour, unlike their look", rather than a punchy garlic taste.

2020年11月のオープン記念イベントでは子どもたちが親のためにそうめん料理を作.en: At the November 2020 opening event, a "kids' restaurant" had children cook somen dishes for the parents, while the adults were invited on a Himeji Castle tour: a community-building event.

2020年5月1日、姫路城の麓・本町68の家老屋敷B棟（かつての武家屋敷エリア）.en: A small restaurant opened on 1 May 2020 in building B of the chief-retainer residences at Honmachi 68, at the foot of Himeji Castle (a former samurai-residence area). Among the historic buildings below the castle, it serves as a lunch stop for tourists and locals between castle visits.

2022年6月の地元メディア報道では、オープン前の店舗にカレーやナン、タンドリー.en: In June 2022 local media reported a "grand opening soon" notice on the shop front showing curry, naan and tandoori chicken, building up local anticipation.

2024年6月15日オープン。船場川沿いの古民家を改装した空間で、大きな窓と庭を.en: Opened 15 June 2024. In a renovated old house beside the Senba River; the counter seats overlook a large window and garden with a view of Himeji Castle's keep. Popular from the start as a lunch with a view of the castle.

2024年7月、創業100年を超える姫路の酒蔵「龍力（本田商店）」とコラボし、イ.en: In July 2024, opened a rooftop restaurant on the 4th floor of Egret Himeji in collaboration with Tatsuriki (Honda Shoten), a Himeji brewery over 100 years old, serving special Tatsuriki sake not available elsewhere.

2025年2月からカフェ営業（月・水〜金 12:30〜16:00）をスタート。デ.en: Café hours began in February 2025 (Mon and Wed–Fri, 12:30–16:00). The hideaway bistro, once dinner-only, now opens in the daytime too, with sweets and café-only drinks.

2025年9月1日に姫路市久保町にオープン。 山陽姫路駅から徒歩約5分、MIST.en: Opened 1 September 2025 in Kubo-cho, Himeji. A small koryori restaurant on the 1st floor of the MISTRAL Kubo-cho building, about 5 minutes' walk from Sanyo-Himeji Station.

20種以上のカレー（辛さ5段階調整可）と石窯（タンドール）焼きナン.en: Over 20 curries (spiciness adjustable in five levels) and naan from a tandoor oven

Deli-koma と oishii-shinshu が『無添加と地産地消』『無.en: Deli-koma and oishii-shinshu introduce the concept, 'additive-free and local production for local consumption' and 'gentle flavours without MSG', and say the owner came from Kimagure Hachibei. Vegewel states 'ramen-making without barriers', vegan ramen, wheat-free noodles and allergy care.

Go! NAGANO（id20535）は総料理担当を小川真宏氏（漢字は真宏）とし.en: Go! NAGANO (id20535) names Ogawa Masahiro (written 真宏) as head of cooking, running the Fuchinobo kitchen for about 30 years, and describes the signature 'Mangetsu' as a steamed dish of Matsushiro Chinese yam skin wrapped around a shiitake-walnut miso filling. The official syojin.html calls Mangetsu 'the lodging's speciality' and lists sesame tofu in every course. The Zenkoji official site confirms the alternative name 'Engi-dō'. The head priest Wakaomi Takanori's view of shojin is also confirmed in press reports.

JR鳥羽駅名店街内の食堂（旧店名「大家族」）。テーブル席と座敷で計約30席。「ネ.en: A diner inside the JR Toba Station shopping arcade (formerly called 'Daikazoku'). About 30 seats at tables and on tatami. It 'closes when the fish runs out', and the famous seafood bowl often sells out by evening. At lunch almost everything is cooked by one person, so there may be a wait. Also serves big fried shrimp, sashimi set meals, Ise udon and grilled turban shell.

KissPress・Tanosu・budou-chan・姫路経済新聞より。202.en: From KissPress, Tanosu, budou-chan and the Himeji Keizai Shimbun. Opened 1 May 2024 in Okada, the first food venture of the amusement-equipment company GP&M. The manager (named differently in two sources) loves music and curry, and the name comes from a wish to recreate the taste of Shupura, an Indian restaurant (now closed) frequented as a student in Matsumoto (Nagano). Rice curry with 15 spices, keema plus chicken, bone-in chicken. budou-chan and KissPress state gluten-free and no butter.

Official site: 「旬の食材を吟味し料理長が真心を込めた物をご提供し.en: Official site: "We serve dishes of carefully chosen seasonal ingredients, prepared by the head chef with heart. Local kaiseki devoted to each season's bounty of the mountains and rivers."

PR TIMES（1.000048612）は運営を合同会社U.I.interna.en: PR TIMES (1.000048612) says it is run by U.I.international LLC (head: Tomoki Kimishima); after the first shop in Yudanaka (2016), the Zenkoji Monzen shop opened on 20 September 2019 in a converted Taishō-era tabi (sock) merchant's house; and Shinshu miso has about half the national market. chomiryo.jp says Isazaki Saizo, in charge of menu development, joined part-time in the second year of university and stayed after graduating, turning down a job offer elsewhere.

PR TIMES（171.000044858）は2025年6月2日開業、運営は軽.en: PR TIMES (171.000044858) says it opened on 2 June 2025, run by Fons Co. of Karuizawa (operator of Kawakamian), in the former Takizawa Shoten building (over 100 years old), reusing a signboard by Akiyama Hakugan, and serving Sanada-maru (local chicken) dishes. blog.nagano-ken carries a comment from manager 眞倉博之: 'Few places stay open in the evening, so we hope people will drop in at night too and that we can help revitalise the area.'

PR TIMES（ATE-LINK運営・2026年3月20日グランフェスタ5番街.en: PR TIMES (run by ATE-LINK; opened in Gran Festa 5-ban-gai on 20 March 2026; café 11–15, night 16–23; chicken-cutlet fried rice over 1 kg in total; at night "YORU NO MARUMASA" with roast beef etc.), budou-chan (started in Fukusaki; huge portions; ¥50 reusable containers), and a search confirming Instagram @kissalavuri420 = "Kissa Lavuri (高橋恵美)".

Retty・食べログ・chirickで確認：鳥羽駅至近のさざえ街、生簀から選んで.en: Confirmed on Retty, Tabelog and chirick: on Sazae Street near Toba Station; choose from the tank and have it charcoal-grilled; turban shells, large clams, abalone, whitebait from Toshijima; hiogi scallops (like scallops, with a rich flavour); local sake; dogs allowed by reservation.

TANOSU取材・姫路みたいより。2018年6月、自宅倉庫を改装して開業。店主は.en: From a TANOSU feature and Himeji Mitai. Opened in June 2018 in a renovated home storehouse. The owner's name is given. Allergy-friendly cakes use rice-flour sponge with no egg, dairy or wheat ("Komeyoshi" also has no soy), but the regular cakes use domestic wheat flour, and some items use wheat, such as fresh wheat gluten. Made-to-order allergy-friendly and character cakes available.

TANOSU取材記事・てくてくひめじ・公式サイトより。アスリート夫婦(片方はFI.en: From a TANOSU feature, Tekuteku Himeji and the official site. An organic café run by an athlete couple (one a FIFA international football referee). Moved from Otsu-ku to Shikama-ku Kamo and reopened in January 2025. Learned roasting at JOKI COFFEE in Kochi; offers five kinds of beans. Serves a rice-flour waffle and rice-flour carrot cake (gluten-free), but also bakes its own bread with organic Haruyokoi wheat and rye (not a dedicated GF kitchen).

TOBA Pearl Town公式ページが、いせえびを鳥羽湾・真珠島・行き交う船.en: The TOBA Pearl Town official page introduces Iseebi as one of the few places in Toba where you can eat looking out over Toba Bay, Pearl Island and passing boats, and confirms a menu of Ise lobster, abalone, fried shrimp curry, sashimi set meals and more.

TV番組「マツコの知らない世界」では、きな粉のスペシャリスト穴沢聖子が「ぜいみ.en: On a TV programme, a kinako specialist (穴沢聖子) introduced "Zeimi Fukuyutaka", and the flavour of kinako made from Fukuyutaka, a premium soybean from Saga, was featured.

Tabelogで2014年2月28日開店・北海道出身の店主・ジンホル鍋(ジンギス.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 28 February 2014; an owner from Hokkaido; jinhoru hot pot (jingisukan lamb + offal) ¥1,180; sea urchin sent directly from Hokkaido; the connoisseur's way of dipping Nishiyama ramen in the sauce and meat juices. Pork / miso offal and sea urchin at ¥1,800 are not stated, so softened.

Tabelogとma8coroはヤマサ蒲鉾直営、大手前エリアの2階、券売機式カウ.en: Tabelog and ma8coro confirm: run directly by Yamasa Kamaboko; 2F in the Otemae area; ticket-machine counter; soba eaten with salt; Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce). The official yumenosoba.com confirms 80/20 soba made with buckwheat flour from Yumesaki.

Tabelogは2025/9/1開業、久保町MISTRALビル1階、山陽姫路駅徒.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 1 September 2025; MISTRAL Bldg 1F, Kubo-cho; about 5 min walk from Sanyo-Himeji Station; a proprietress who is a registered dietitian; always over 10 Harima local sakes. Hot Pepper confirms healthy daily obanzai of freshly picked vegetables.

Vegewel・Hachidory・てくてくひめじ・Instagramより。姫路.en: From Vegewel, Hachidory, Tekuteku Himeji and Instagram. A vegan restaurant at Nishi-Shinzaike 1-1-8, Himeji. Tekuteku records: the owners, a couple (one a pastry chef); 6 years at a hotel on Ishigaki Island and 5 years on Okinawa's main island; opened September 2014; moved from Nishi-Imajuku to the present site in February 2020. About 50 kinds of pesticide-free vegetables, cooked completely additive-free. Lunch is a reservation-only course for one group a day (2–4 people); GF vegan baked sweets on sale from noon. One owner's given name appears only on the owner's own Instagram (@cafuu3283), and its reading is not publicly confirmed.

aquarium.co.jp/school/lunch: 海の見えるレストラン「.en: aquarium.co.jp/school/lunch: 'Bayside', a restaurant with a sea view; Ise udon / ramen / curry / fried rice sets, a low-allergen curry, a 28-allergen table (for school groups). Tabelog 24011542: ocean view of Toba Bay; Ise udon curry, shoyu ramen, fried chicken bowl, soft serve.

budou-chanで店主はイタリアン・和食・焼き鳥を経て2015年に開店、本町.en: budou-chan confirms: the owner worked in Italian, Japanese and yakitori before opening in 2015; Honmachi 68, near the castle; the name honours a woman who ran a bread and grocery shop in Aboshi for 40 years; visits to Sri Lanka (not India); over 10 spices and the words "I worked it out in my head and made it edible". tanosu confirms 11 seats, a vegan tofu and bean curry developed for foreign tourists' dietary restrictions, and Awaji Island onions.

budou-chanは2018/10/18開業、清交倶楽部運営（Miketide.en: budou-chan confirms: opened 18 October 2018; run by Seiko Club (Miketide, Fukutei and others); 1F of the Daiwa Roynet Hotel; frontages on both the Route 2 side and the Miyuki-dori side. The official gorp site and Gurunavi confirm Himeji's famous conger eel, about 15 Harima local sakes always available, and Dr.Fry (a cooking machine that reduces oil absorption).

budou-chan・himeji-mitaiで2022年7月、ビエラ姫路（南駅.en: budou-chan and himeji-mitai confirm it opened in July 2022 in Viera Himeji (Minami-Ekimae-cho 125) as an Indian and Nepalese restaurant, with five spiciness levels, many sets and a mild Nepalese-style curry. Hot Pepper confirms over 20 curries (the original's "over 22" was wrong) and various tandoor-baked naans. The pre-opening notice in June 2022 is confirmed by budou-chan.

budou-chan・il-riccio.com公式が、みゆき通りで創業48年を.en: budou-chan and il-riccio.com confirm: it grew out of a natural-foods shop that reached 48 years on Miyuki-dori; moved to Gofukucho (Gofukucho 18) in November 2019 and restarted as a plant-based café and natural-foods shop; the owner teaches macrobiotic cooking; a 100% plant-based, organic policy; the name (hedgehog). Allergy-free is not guaranteed.

budou-chan・ramen-miyako公式で京都をテーマにしたラーメン京.en: budou-chan and the ramen-miyako official site confirm: Ramen Kyo (Miyako), a Kyoto-themed chain with shops in Kyoto, Hyogo, Nara and Shiga; next to the 2F ticket gates of Sanyo-Himeji Station; low-temperature-aged thin noodles and "Gion paitan"; chashu and a soft-boiled egg. Closed 6–16 October 2025 and reopened on 17 October as "Ekimen Ramen Kyo", introducing value sets such as ¥660.

budou-chan・tanosuで2023年7月14日、西二階町にごはんとプレ.en: budou-chan and tanosu confirm it opened on 14 July 2023 in Nishi-Nikaimachi as the second shop of Gohan to Plate Zigzag (Higashiyama), switching to obanzai. tanosu confirms Bizen ware inherited from the family home displayed on the shelves; kisspress confirms miso soup with three misos and daily dashi; ameblo confirms a 16-kind daily obanzai set meal (¥1,980 before tax) and that over 90% of customers are women.

budou-chan・食べログで、創業82年、店名は曽祖父が敬慕した勝海舟に由来.en: budou-chan and Tabelog confirm: 82 years in business; the name comes from Katsu Kaishu, admired by the founder's great-grandfather; once four shops, now one; tonkatsu and tonjiru are the specialties; TV appearances. Pork in the omurice is unconfirmed, so it is softened to "said to".

budou-chan（open-casaisola）はバーミリオン出身のシェフ、.en: budou-chan (open-casaisola) confirms: a chef from Vermillion; creative charcoal-grilled Italian with Ieshima seafood; opened in Shikama on 30 July 2020; the meaning of the name. kaitenheiten records the closure on 19 June 2026 and the move to Minami-machi on 3 July. Tabelog and Instagram (@casa.isola = 村角徳昭) confirm the new shop at Minami-machi 60-2, 86 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station, the 3 July opening and the chef's name.

dainichi-nagano（2025/04）は大勧進・紫雲閣内の寺院カフェで.en: dainichi-nagano (April 2025) confirms a temple café in Daikanjin's Shiunkaku; the ¥1,500 shojin porridge set; Obuse chestnut sweets; the custom of choosing a monk's handwritten chopstick sleeve to take home; and a tatami room overlooking the main gate, main hall and lotus pond. Run by Izutsuya Tetsuji (from December 2024, per Daikanjin materials).

deli-komaでイタリアで修業したオーナー・クレジット不可(現金のみ)・24.en: deli-koma confirms: an owner who trained in Italy; no credit cards (cash only); 24 seats (about 6 tables); simple yet authentic flavours that make the most of the ingredients; plenty of starters, meat and fish; nearest station Zenkoji-shita. There is no source for a Tuscan style or carpaccio, so softened or removed.

e-cocooo・smilenavi・web-komachi・primelife.en: e-cocooo, smilenavi, web-komachi and primelifenet agree: opened June 2019; the owner moved from Tokyo; open Thursday to Saturday only; Nagano-grown (partly Hokkaido) wheat, wholemeal and rye flours; natural yeast from Nagano fruit and the owner's own pesticide-free wheat; home-grown strawberries; hard campagne loaves and vegan croissants.

e-sousyoku・公式・tanosu・kisspress・budou-cha.en: e-sousyoku, the official site, tanosu, kisspress and budou-chan confirm: 川原亜弥 moved from the beauty business to bread; opened in April 2010; it began with a partner's love of New York burgers (a past dream of studying in the US went unrealised); 20+ bagels from a Hokkaido Haruyutaka blend with Hoshino natural yeast; 100% Aussie beef burgers; being sustained by customers saying "delicious"; and the story of being "too handsome to show [a] face" before the second shop. A claim of a research trip to the US could not be verified and was corrected.

fujiyaheigoro公式・thefujiyagohonjin・sheage.en: The fujiyaheigoro official site, thefujiyagohonjin, sheage and searches back up: the founding of the Fujiya honjin in 1648; the name Heigoro passed down the generations; visits by Itō Hirobumi and Fukuzawa Yukichi; the 1925 Western-style building; registered tangible cultural property in 1997; becoming THE FUJIYA GOHONJIN in 2006; and in 2012 moving from Patio Daimon to the Fujiya annex as the main shop. The anecdote of a shop looking ahead to reopening the inn was removed because its source (Yahoo) now returns 404.

gf-akane（小麦アレルギーのブロガー）が松本店のGF米系麺（玄米麺）と、通.en: gf-akane (a blogger with a wheat allergy) describes the Matsumoto shop's GF rice-type noodles (brown-rice noodles), usually boiled in the same pot as the wheat noodles but in a separate pot on request. The official samurai-noodle.jp states the roasted-miso brand (Sapporo, Shibuya, Azumino, Matsumoto), oriental-vegetarian options in Shibuya and Matsumoto, and rice-flour noodles. Tabelog confirms the address (Takamiya-kita 3-1), hours and closing on the third Wednesday. Safety for celiac diners is not guaranteed.

gibierto と web-komachi がホテル勤務14年超、2019年開.en: gibierto and web-komachi back up over 14 years working in hotels, opening in 2019, game venison dishes, Neapolitan pizza of a Shinshu + Italian wheat blend, a green exterior and about 24 seats. The venison steak sauce is described as a seasonal berry sauce.

goguynetで2023年12月8日開店・お溝筋商店街（二階町）、食べログで全.en: goguynet confirms the opening on 8 December 2023 in the Omizo-suji arcade (Nikaimachi); Tabelog confirms 11 seats (3 counter, two 4-person tables) and a weekday lunch (sashimi, tempura, chawanmushi, etc.). nomu220 confirms the ¥1,000 daily lunch and the story of being served bottled beer at the draft price when the draft ran out.

goguynet：2024年6月15日オープン、姫路城西側・船場川沿いの古民家を.en: goguynet: opened 15 June 2024; a renovated old house beside the Senba River, west of Himeji Castle; counter and garden with a view of the keep; only a chef's-choice lunch at ¥3,300 (tax included); pickles and dressings handmade.

himeji-festa（播州室津・吉田水産の直営店、グランフェスタ6番街、浜焼.en: Confirmed by himeji-festa (run directly by Yoshida Suisan of Banshu Murotsu; Gran Festa 6-ban-gai; hama-yaki), the official maruhou.owst.jp (hama-yaki at every seat; seasonal all-you-can-eat November–May; cooked from the tank after ordering) and himeji588 (¥1,000 oyster set plus free steamed oysters for an Instagram follow; Murotsu oysters).

himeji-spice・tanosu・kisspress・tekuteku が.en: himeji-spice, tanosu, kisspress and tekuteku confirm: the owner; experience at the cave café TEEDA; opened 13 July 2025; Honmachi 68, Himekoji 2F (an old house about 70 years old); the origin of the name; a 100% plant-based menu; taco rice ¥1,500; rice-flour and okara muffins; care for nut allergies (no almond flour); a bring-your-own tie-up with KUUHAKU COFFEE. Full GF or allergy safety is not asserted.

himeji588（2016）は店主金井千秋（千秋ママ）、母からの約6年前の継承.en: himeji588 (2016) confirms: the owner, 金井千秋 ("Mama"); took over from a parent about six years earlier; 8 seats; Tajima chicken slaughtered that morning; skewers from ¥130. The ma8coro blog records that hine-pon is pre-prepared so it comes out fast, and the grilled bone-in mature-hen thigh (no source says the shop originated it).

hitosaraは日本料理・懐石/会席、上階のウイスキーバー、瀬戸内の魚、冬のふ.en: hitosara confirms: Japanese cuisine, kaiseki and banquet courses; a whisky bar upstairs; Seto Inland Sea fish; in winter, fugu (tessa), oysters, conger eel and duck hot pot. The years in business ("decades") and "over 100 dishes" could not be confirmed in sources, so each was softened.

hitosara人物ページ（生年月日・二代目・人柄）、magazine.hito.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara profile page (date of birth, second generation, personality), magazine.hitosara (about 50 years in business, i.e. since around 1970; raised in Shiso; over 20 years after training in Kyoto and Kobe; the family's own rice from Shiso), the official news/631 (wild conger eel 5–10 times the price; sewage-treatment risk; steaming), and favy (a Hyogo restaurant guide; Kansai TV's Yo-i Don).

hitosara店舗ページ（有本良・1985年兵庫・Hummingbird 20.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara shop page (有本良; born in Hyogo in 1985; joined in 2018 from Hummingbird 2000), the official site (the shop that originated anago-meshi; ginger in the sauce; grilled then steamed; 1 min walk from Omizo-suji), tanosu (fresh conger eel all year, rare even in the city; the original sauce brushed on and turned 2–4 times) and kisspress (12 years; three ways to eat it).

hotpepper と gnavi が城山公園内・1905年（明治38年）創業、.en: Hot Pepper and Gurunavi back up its location in Shiroyama Park, founding in 1905 (Meiji 38), the tradition that its name comes from Emperor Meiji's words 'What a view!', kaiseki of Shinshu ingredients, and room for up to 200 people.

irohado.com/en は1925年12月木曽（鬼無里）創業、パン・和菓子.en: irohado.com/en says it was founded in December 1925 in Kiso (Kinasa), switched from bread and Japanese sweets to oyaki in the 1960s; fourth-generation president 伊藤博武; about 130 employees; the Nakamise shop opened in May 2020; Grand Prix at the 75th Japan Food Selection (May 2024). shun-gate reports that a vegetable oyaki is hand-wrapped in about 20 seconds, a skill that takes about a year to learn; Oyaki Farm makes 8,000–14,000 a day; and the president's comment that they go well with beer and coffee.

irukara・reo-gourmet・boooonで確認：オーナー和田幸夫（松.en: Confirmed on irukara, reo-gourmet and Boooon: owner Wada Yukio (born in Matsumoto → Nagano; to Tokyo for interior design; scaffolder 6–7 years; hotel food service, then 4 years of lunches borrowing a bar's daytime → independent). Concept Mr Sunday Trip; the firm Sunday Retro Pudding (with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi); coffee jelly with Matsuda milk from a 100-year-old Omachi dairy; daily single-origin coffee.

iseshima 115013: 地元の魚介類を使った海鮮居酒屋、海鮮丼が人気、.en: iseshima 115013: a seafood izakaya using local seafood; the seafood bowl is popular; open at lunch, daytime drinking welcome; #solo diners very welcome. Tabelog 24015561: genres seafood, tempura, izakaya; seafood bowl, Ise lobster sashimi, premium nigiri.

it-marketing・ヒトサラ・検索で、安田忠正は1968年兵庫県生まれ、ホ.en: it-marketing, Hitosara and searches confirm: 安田忠正, born in Hyogo in 1968, cooked for professional baseball players at a hotel, then went independent with live cooking; Kiko Live Food runs Omotenashi Kikou, Bettei Tanikatsu and Senhime Chaya; listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide; chairs the Hyogo specialty products association. Tatsuriki's official site confirms the July 2024 opening on Egret's 4th floor.

kaisei-toba.com: 鳥羽一番街3F、鳥羽駅近く、お客様の要望で開業.en: kaisei-toba.com: Toba Ichiban-gai 3F, near Toba Station; opened at customers' request; memories of a trip; heart and soul in every meal; seasonal seafood bowls, the Isooke set (abalone sashimi), Matsusaka beef set, tonteki. Tabiiro/search: opened July 2025.

keizai.biz が、オーナー小谷建治氏、2023-10-17開業、英国風パ.en: keizai.biz confirms: the owner; opened 17 October 2023; 15 years as a bartender at a British-style pub; the philosophy of pairing oden with craft gin; Himeji-style oden in a dashi of Rausu kombu, bonito and tuna flakes with ginger soy sauce; all-you-can-drink of 40 gins for ¥4,000.

keizai.biz・budou-chan が、2017-03-01開業（テンヤ.en: keizai.biz and budou-chan confirm: opened 1 March 2017 (former Tenya site); the owner; about 20 years' training from age 18, including in Izushi; hand-made soba in view through the window; the warabi mochi served since opening; still full at lunch eight years on.

keizai.biz・food-stadium・inshokuten・らくちん公.en: keizai.biz, food-stadium, inshokuten and Rakuchin's official site confirm the Kyoto origin (Bistro Frenchman, 2015), the representative's career, the head chef, the move to the casual-tavern format, and the Himeji opening date and sales of each shop.

keizai.biz・kisspress・tanosu・budou-chan が.en: keizai.biz, kisspress, tanosu and budou-chan confirm: opened 6 April 2024 in the Omizo-suji arcade; about 6 tsubo with 8 counter seats; ice from Shinshu deep natural water (about 250 m); completely unheated fresh syrups; open all year; plans for fruit sandwiches and tea. The owner's given name is not public in any article, so only the surname is given.

keizai.biz・まねき食品公式・budou-chan が、2024-03-.en: keizai.biz, Maneki Foods' official site and budou-chan confirm: opened 22 March 2024; Maneki Foods (founded 1888, originator of station soba, from 1949); the company president; eight wines supervised by a celebrity; the former jewellery shop site on Miyuki-dori (Liv Along); terracotta interior; shrimp soba.

kisspress が、祖父母の戦後居酒屋→割烹天平→2010年グリル天平への継.en: kisspress confirms: the grandparents' post-war izakaya, then Kappo Tenpei, then Grill Tenpei in 2010; the concept of a table shared by three generations; the origin of the name; pesticide-free, home-grown vegetables and Shiga Koshihikari rice; very close to Himeji Castle (about 300 steps); a children's cafeteria since 2018; Himeji wagyu hamburg steak with a demi-glace made over three days.

kochiki（創業70年）とgoguynetは昭和21年（1946）創業を裏付.en: kochiki (70 years in business) and goguynet confirm founding in 1946 (Showa 21); kochiki records the staff-meal origin of the shumai, eating it with sauce and mustard, and chuka soba with kombu and niboshi. No source confirmed a specific 1952 move, so it was removed.

krkjapan（2022）は神奈川生まれ・姫路育ち、16年の会社員（管理職）、.en: krkjapan (2022) confirms: born in Kanagawa, raised in Himeji; 16 years as a company employee (manager); about half a year persuading family; opened 4 November 2015; ramen that brings to mind the ingredients and the producers; niboshi and jidori chicken. Tabelog records the move and renaming on 23 December 2023, kombu-water tsukemen, and awards at Shikou no Ramen Kansai (runner-up in 2025).

local-primeはオーナー兼料理長・博多勝也、築100年以上の古民家、城壁.en: local-prime confirms: the owner and head chef, 博多勝也; an old house over 100 years old; located northwest along the castle walls; Daimyo Tsuzura (10+ dishes plus matcha fondue); the matcha sauce perfected by the owner's partner; mizuhiki and baran work modelled on Himeji Castle. tanosu confirms that Daimyo Tsuzura changes daily and the handmade sesame tofu.

ma8coroブログが、旧『なかもと』の跡地・常連継承・鍋を囲むL字約6席・約3.en: The ma8coro blog confirms: on the site of the former "Nakamoto", taking over its regulars; about 6 seats in an L-shape around the pot; about 30 ingredients; yuba, grilled green onion, ginkgo, tsumire and bamboo shoots; local sake "Naruto-tai" and "Miyakobijin". Miyakobijin is read "miyakobijin". The owner's name is not public.

ma8coro：駅前町の橋本ビル2階、妻が居酒屋・夫が階下でラーメン店、沖縄のゆ.en: ma8coro: Hashimoto Bldg 2F, Ekimae-cho; one partner runs the izakaya, the other a ramen shop downstairs; laid-back Okinawan music; Harima local sake at reasonable prices (Oku-Harima junmai ¥500, Sennenichi ¥600, etc.); a conversation with a German guest about sake prices. Listed on Tabelog as opened 3 October 2025.

musicbird・iimono.town・かいてん/へいてん24が、Forwa.en: musicbird, iimono.town and Kaiten/Heiten 24 confirm: run by Forward ball LLC; opened 13 May 2026; honetsuki-dori began at Ikkaku in 1953; mature hen and young chicken; seasoning measured to the milligram; Sanuki Cloudy. The founders' names were corrected from the Wikipedia article on honetsuki-dori.

myhimejimapのインタビューで店主・浅見義人（姫路出身）、エスニック店→.en: A myhimejimap interview confirms: the owner, 浅見義人 (from Himeji); an ethnic restaurant, then about 8 years at a Michelin-starred French restaurant in Osaka; returned home on a mentor's advice; the name Aigrette = egret (from Shirasagi Castle, i.e. Himeji Castle), likened to Fernand Point's La Pyramide; the Honmachi 68 address; a partner is a sommelier. tekuteku-himeji confirms eggplant curry on the 22nd of each month, a natural-wine evening on the 20th, and vegetables from Yunomae, Harima-nada fish, Tajima chicken and Himeji wagyu.

nagano-gondo（インタビュー）・hahahaishya・食べログで確認.en: nagano-gondo (interview), hahahaishya and Tabelog confirm: 47 years since coming down from Togakushi, the home of soba; at the Gondo arcade by the entrance to Nagano Aioi-za; 11 counter seats; the owner alone. 'Nothing special about us, but we do our very best to make good soba.' Tororo soba (botchi-mori, egg yolk), celebrity autographs, Omakura (9 bundles) and soba water.

nagano-webtownで裏路地・権堂駅と善光寺から各徒歩約6分・サンセット.en: nagano-webtown confirms: in a back alley, about 6 minutes' walk from both Gondo Station and Zenkoji; Sunset Plaza 103; 7 seats (3 at the counter, 4 at tables); the owner cooks and serves alone; Richard Ginori, Wedgwood and Riedel tableware. The seasonal pastas and gelatos are based on Tabelog reviews.

naganogourmet（2019/04/23）は建物が施主の祖父（1979年.en: naganogourmet (23 April 2019) says the building was the calligraphy school run by the owner's grandfather (who died in 1979 aged 93), that former pupils from 50–60 years ago visit, and that tea is carefully brewed. sweets.nagano confirms house-made cakes such as roll cake, tarts, clafoutis and cheesecake. The owner's name 'Hisako' and 'uses home-made pottery' appear in no source, so both were removed.

nagatabe・boooon が店内石臼挽き（入口から見える）、チェーンではな.en: nagatabe and Boooon back up stone milling in the shop (visible from the entrance), an independent shop rather than a chain, and a daily lunch at ¥980 on weekdays and ¥1,130 at weekends (cold or hot soba, mini tempura bowl, chilled tofu, soba dumplings, pickles).

otto2008.com（自社サイト）は本店を株式会社otto運営と裏付ける。ホ.en: otto2008.com (the company's own site) confirms the main shop is run by otto Co. Hot Pepper records Himeji Noren-gai, the Shin Festa Building, 1 min from the station, Himeji oden from ¥176 (homemade ginger soy sauce) and kushikatsu from ¥132. tanosu confirms castle-shaped konjac and bokkake.

reo-gourmet・note・hahahaishya・まいぷれで確認：202.en: Confirmed on reo-gourmet, note, hahahaishya and Mypl: opened April 2022; 726 Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City, across from Yubuku Shrine; a two-storey townhouse with a manga corner on the first floor; Judee Sill's 'Heart Food' playing on a Toshiba CD player and Bose Bluetooth; breakfast from 8 am; Chinese zongzi set, brown-rice latte, lemon cake; the name Sirafu means 'sober'.

reo-gourmet・食べログで確認：善光寺西側、湯福神社隣接、昭和30年代築.en: Confirmed on reo-gourmet and Tabelog: west of Zenkoji, next to Yubuku Shrine, a renovated old house built in the 1950s–60s, slippers inside, copper-griddle pancakes, fresh-pasta lunch, cat-themed interior, Kenyan tea shaved ice in summer. Address: 723 Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City. The origin of the name (a Spanish theory) could not be backed up, so it was removed.

retty.news・web-komachi・reo-gourmet が、鉄道会.en: retty.news, web-komachi and reo-gourmet back up: leaving a railway-company job to go independent, early retirement around age 50, training prompted by a retirement gift, the 67-degree theory and low-temperature, residual-heat cooking, four pork brands (Shinshu SPF, Chiyo Maboroshi, Azumino free-range and Yamato pork), choosing the cut from a block of meat, and Daifukuya (a 100-year-old used-book shop and café).

savorjapan と hitosara が料理長・中村義信（1976年長野県.en: savorjapan and Hitosara state head chef Nakamura Yoshinobu (born 1976 in Nagano Prefecture; trained in Nagano and Tokyo; opened in 2005; moved to Patio Daimon in 2014 and added Tempura Kakure Shunka). The Patio Daimon official site says the building, 'Yokikan', is a mid-Meiji reception hall restored over 100 years later. The hahahaishya blog reports the move to the second floor of the annex after a fire and signature dishes such as 'the chef's ohagi'.

shinise.tvは小菅亭を1895年（明治28年）創業・130年超の老舗とし.en: shinise.tv describes Kosugetei as a long-established shop founded in 1895 (Meiji 28), over 130 years old; in 1941 fire regulations moved it from the Zenkoji grounds to Higashi-no-mon-cho; it served soba to Emperor Shōwa and Prince Takamatsu and supplied the Zenkoji Gokaichō. i-turn and the official site confirm coarse-ground Japanese buckwheat (mainly from Shinshu and Hokkaido) and duck dishes. Detailed dashi ratios and a line saying 'check allergies before ordering' could not be confirmed, so they were removed.

shinise・retty・自社ECサイトが江戸期（1700年代）創業、18代目.en: shinise, Retty and the company's own online shop back up a founding in the Edo period (the 1700s), the 18th generation, the shop dog Kentaro, and the famous green onion–miso–cheese oyaki and nozawana oyaki. When it started making oyaki is not stated, so it was written loosely.

shiojitei.jp/cuisine/kiyoishi.html: 料理人が.en: shiojitei.jp/cuisine/kiyoishi.html: the chefs go to the Toshijima market in person to buy ingredients directly; eat each season's food in its season; Ise lobster, abalone, Matsusaka beef; ingredients also used as offerings to the gods; deft knife work in front of you.

snowmonkey・kaiseki-tsumugi公式・patio-daimo.en: snowmonkey, the kaiseki-tsumugi official site, patio-daimon and a prefectural game blog back up Machida Tetsuya (born 1980, from Nagano), Machida's wife 由起子, training at Tsurukō in Kanazawa, opening in March 2022, a Taishō-era storehouse in Patio Daimon, 100% buckwheat soba, and Utsukushigahara Plateau venison with Nagano honey and balsamic.

sobaweb報告で自家製粉の二八そば・細打ち・黒い星が少ない白色系・喉越し良く.en: A sobaweb report confirms in-house-milled nihachi soba, thin-cut, a whitish type with few dark specks, smooth to swallow, the duck dipping soba well reviewed, and fair prices. An nta article confirms a sweet, gentle dashi of thick-shaved aged bonito and the duck dipping soba. 4travel confirms it closes when the soba sells out and gives generous portions (plain soba about ¥650). 587-3 Daimon-chō, on the south side of Zenkoji Daihongan.

sweetsguide.jp と lumierellc.net によれば、Mie.en: According to sweetsguide.jp and lumierellc.net, Miel Yakigashi Koubou is an allergy-friendly baked-sweets workshop run by Lumiere LLC (Shikama-ku Kamo 339-8). No egg, dairy or wheat is brought in; made with rice flour, potato starch, soy milk, sugar, rice or rapeseed oil, almond and aluminium-free baking powder. Offers butter-free madeleines, baked doughnuts, cookies, soy-milk pudding and allergy-friendly cakes. Founded from the wish that children with allergies could eat the same treats as everyone else. The representative's name is not listed.

tabelog 24018534: JR鳥羽駅2分の食事処、生牡蠣・浜焼き・刺身.en: Tabelog 24018534: a restaurant 2 minutes from JR Toba Station; raw oysters, grilled seafood, sashimi, shellfish, Ise lobster. Reviews: the real taste of Toba while waiting for a train; the shellfish and Ise lobster are delicious.

tabelog 24020560: 2019年の大晦日から焼肉創の裏に増設、締め.en: Tabelog 24020560: added behind Yakiniku Sou from New Year's Eve 2019, for a bowl to finish the night; rich coarse-filtered shoyu ramen, Matsusaka beef offal ramen (¥1,100), fried gyoza, famous chicken wings. Hot Pepper: win an arm-wrestling match for a discount.

tabelog 24020730: 2024年1月1日オープン、中華料理店トント.en: Tabelog 24020730: opened 1 January 2024 in the former Chinese restaurant Tonton, near Toba Station; large and extra-huge portions, free extra-large rice; fried chicken, miso katsu, tonkatsu and fried shrimp set meals.

tabelog が2012年3月11日開業（夫婦・町家）、nagano2shin.en: Tabelog backs up an opening on 11 March 2012 (a couple, in a townhouse); nagano2shin backs up the end of pizza service on 27 November 2021 and weekend takeout during the transition; naganogourmet backs up the move to a takeout sandwich shop that tends to sell out; hahahaishya backs up eat-in pizza at TIKU-Plus (tomato, cheese and basil ¥1,550). The origin of the cheeses (Okayama, Hokkaido, Nagano) could not be confirmed, so it was generalised.

tanosu・kisspressで、梅澤糧穀（1920年創業）の福沢町の倉庫を改.en: tanosu and kisspress confirm: a renovated warehouse of Umezawa Ryokoku (founded 1920) in Fukusawa-cho; reopened on 29 July 2024 by the previous owner's daughter after about nine years, at first run alone; pesticide-free "Yume-hana" soybeans from Yumesaki; house-made yuba sashimi and Taiwanese-style soy milk.

tanosu・local-prime・budou-chan・公式(うさぎ)より。.en: From tanosu, local-prime, budou-chan and the official (Usagi) site. Opened 15 April 2022 on 2F of the Kamihata Building in front of Sanyo-Himeji Station. Known for a homemade black beef curry (three days' preparation), developed by the owner of Shokusaiya Usagi after researching curries across Japan, and five colours of cream soda. About 70 Fukunaga Green (melon + vanilla) a day. The number of spices varies by source: about 30, or 8–9.

tanosu・tekuteku両記事：オーナーはマクロビとの出会いから約2010.en: Both tanosu and tekuteku articles: the owner started making sweets around 2010 after discovering macrobiotics; active at the Children's Theatre in 2017; reopened on 1 April 2020 as a café and rental space in a renovated former inn at Higashi-Nobesue 1-69; a daily vegetable lunch using organic vegetables from Himeji Yuuki Yasai no Kai; baked sweets of brown-rice flour and okara (no wheat); the shoes-off rental space is used for concerts, exhibitions and more. The owner's real name could not be confirmed and is left out.

tanosu・食べログ・公式サイトで、株式会社HILO（代表 田中洋生）が平成1.en: tanosu, Tabelog and the official site confirm: HILO Co., Ltd. (田中洋生, representative) founded in June 2005 (Heisei 17); the representative is the second son of the owner of "Honke Tanaka no Yaki-anago", which closed in March 2019 (Reiwa 1); the main shop seats 35 (5 counter, 6 table, 24 tatami); a Q'Ul Himeji shop opened in April 2016 (Heisei 28).

tanosu（威海市で10年修行・現地で開業経験・牛骨＋約20種漢方・花椒・中国.en: Confirmed by tanosu (10 years' training in Weihai; ran a shop there; beef bone plus about 20 medicinal herbs; huajiao; staff from China; about 50 ingredients), kansai-kaiten (opened April 2026; first in Himeji; Shirasagi Bridge / Uzumi Gate site; about 60 ingredients) and budou-chan (half-price coupons for two pre-opening days). The number of ingredients varies between 50 and 60 by source.

tekuteku-himeji（東京出身・フランス料理修行・結婚を機に姫路へ・2.en: Confirmed by tekuteku-himeji: from Tokyo; trained in French cooking; moved to Himeji on marrying; opened 27 July 2012; moved from Kita-Hirano to Kamiyacho in June 2021; animal-shaped cutlery rests; oyster dishes; "true to deliciousness".

tera-buddha が善光寺39永代宿坊の一つ、体験型宿坊、笹寿司・胡麻豆腐.en: tera-buddha backs up: one of Zenkoji's 39 permanent temple lodgings; a hands-on temple stay; two styles, traditional shojin of sasa-zushi, sesame tofu and yuba, and the Italian-style 'THE SHOJIN'; use by companies, hospitals and sports groups combined with zazen.

toba-iwashitei.com: 答志島から活きた鰯を仕入れ生簀で保管、鰯.en: toba-iwashitei.com: live sardines bought from Toshijima and kept in a tank; with sardines freshness is everything, a specialist's skill; 3 minutes' walk from Toba Station. Tabelog 24001485: more than 50 sardine dishes (sashimi, kabayaki, sweet-simmered, fish balls, steamed, tempura and more).

toba.gr.jp/stay/1799: 天保元年(1830年)創業の老舗旅館.en: toba.gr.jp/stay/1799: a long-established inn founded in 1830 (Tenpō 1), 3 minutes' walk from Toba Station, overlooking Toba Bay. todaya.co.jp/tenchikai: an open live kitchen of about 10 m, a local-fish butchering show, hand-made stone-oven pizza, Japanese and Western dishes.

tobahotel.co.jp/cafe-lounge: オーシャンウイング入口.en: tobahotel.co.jp/cafe-lounge: on the entrance floor of the Ocean Wing, overlooking Toba Bay; lunch, seasonal afternoon tea and hotel-made sweets, by reservation until 17:00 the day before; a bar counter of a single slab of Mie horse chestnut. Tabelog: reopened after renovation on 25 March 2024.

tobahotel.co.jp/mondomisaki: オーシャンウイング3階.en: tobahotel.co.jp/mondomisaki: third floor of the Ocean Wing; resort washoku; Miketsukuni; the chefs go by boat to the Toshijima market; enjoyment from rare finds; Ise lobster, abalone, Matsusaka beef, Kumano beef, Ise red chicken, Matsusaka pork.

tobayakatabune.jp: 三重県唯一の屋形船、マリン沖田が船上での食.en: tobayakatabune.jp: the only houseboat in Mie Prefecture; Marine Okita opened it in 2014 with a dedicated boat after 60 years of serving meals on board; third-generation head chef Sasaki Daisuke; a rooftop observation deck; grilled Ise lobster, abalone and oysters.

torusが海から直接引く海水生簀（伊勢海老も泳ぎ、注文でお造りに）と元海女スタ.en: torus confirms a tank fed directly with seawater from the sea (Ise lobster swim in it too, and become sashimi to order) and the perfect grilling of a former ama diver on the staff. chirick describes large clams, hiogi scallops and turban shells grilled boldly right in front of you (no description of salt or soy seasoning by ingredient could be confirmed, so that line was removed).

web-komachi と mypl が2022年3月19日の善光寺仲見世でのオ.en: web-komachi and mypl back up the opening on Zenkoji Nakamise on 19 March 2022, operation by Oimo Biyori (main shop in Azumino), aging for over 60 days, and the 3 mm Zenkoji Kenpi made with a home-built machine. Kenpi flavours: chili pepper, honey butter, nori salt and sweet sugar.

web-komachi・rurubu・食べログで確認：大正期に清水民蔵が旅館を創.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, Rurubu and Tabelog: an inn founded in the Taishō era by 清水民蔵, renamed Izumiya Ryokan in 1950; the fifth generation, Shimizu Akira (about 30 years in Japanese cuisine), reopened it in April 2022 as a daifuku-and-whisky bar (a return to the origins). About 60 whiskies; the starter is a daifuku (can be taken home); the irori hearth is lit in winter.

web-komachi・ten-japan（吟屋グループ公式）・goguynet.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, ten-japan (Ginya Group official), goguynet and weekend-kanazawa: the Nagano branch is run by the Ginya group (Kawamoto Tenshi) under the supervision of Chuka Soba Kibi's Watanabe Yasuyuki; opened 12 December 2025 in the Gondo arcade (former Kaburamura site). The first Kanazawa shop opened in September 2025, created by Kanazawa's Menya Taiga. Light Chinese soba of hand-crumpled high-hydration noodles ¥900; a soup of pork, chicken and vegetables simmered 10 hours.

web-komachi・まいぷれ・ナガラボ・公式で確認：オーナーシェフ永岡祐二（.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, Mypl, Nagalabo and the official site: owner-chef Nagaoka Yuji (trained in Italy and at THE FUJIYA GOHONJIN) and Nagaoka's wife Kana (from HEIGORO) opened on 25 January 2019 in Hakoshimizu, Nagano City. An old house with herringbone floors, reservations only, the chef goes deep-sea fishing personally (winter yellowtail, blackthroat seaperch, bigfin reef squid), caponata of swordtip squid, and from 12 February 2020 sweets also by reservation.

web-komachi・長野CVBで確認：善光寺門前の築約100年古民家、無添加.en: Confirmed on web-komachi and Nagano CVB: an old house about 100 years old by Zenkoji; about 30 kinds of additive-free hand-made chiffon (6–8 a day); free-range eggs; closes when sold out; the strawberry parfait uses strawberries from Nakano City, Nagano, served December to end of May. The name 菓恋 means 'fell in love with sweets' (the 'cute' theory was wrong, so removed).

web-komachi（p71893）は新小路カフェを1960年代の紙問屋倉庫（.en: web-komachi (p71893) describes Shinkoji Cafe as a converted 1960s paper wholesaler's warehouse (SHINKOJI North Building), run by three homemakers, using carefully chosen ingredients, house-made miso, Koshihikari from Aga in Niigata and vegetables from partner farms, with a health-minded high-protein, low-calorie menu (fish set ¥880).

yomiuri tabiyomiで1975年みゆき通りで八百屋から喫茶へ転換、2.en: yomiuri tabiyomi confirms: switched from a greengrocer to a coffee shop on Miyuki-dori in 1975; the second-generation owner's words "the ingredients matter, just like vegetables"; over 200 seasonal blends; a Showa-retro interior with an L-shaped marble counter and a world map; almond toast spread via Narita Coffee over 30 years ago. tanosu confirms regulars' tastes being guessed at a glance and 50 years of history; Tabelog confirms selection for "Kissa Top 100 2021" (the original's "100 famous music cafés" was wrong).

「うちは米粉だけじゃなくていろんな大豆粉とか入れてる」.en: "We don't just use rice flour, we put in various soybean flours and so on"

「お客様にはとにかくゆっくりしていって欲しい」。コンセプトは『Mr Sunday.en: 'Above all, I want customers to relax and stay a while.' The concept is 'Mr Sunday Trip', an imaginary traveller who collects vintage goods from around the world; the interior is the owner's own collected furniture and one-of-a-kind tableware.

The building's operator provided the empty unit.

Born into a fishing family, the owner picks wild fresh fish personally and buys without middlemen, keeping both freshness and prices right. The specialities are tekone-zushi in limited numbers and fisherman's chazuke. 'The moment a child who dislikes fish says "Delicious!" is the ultimate,' in the owner's words.

A web search backed up that the couple's son trained in Australia and runs the sushi shop 'Mr.q', and that Aji no Kyubei, founded in 1971, is the oldest yakitori izakaya in Toba.

伊勢志摩観光ナビと旅色で確認：シェルレーヌはアコヤ真珠貝型、膨張剤・保存料不使用.en: Confirmed on the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabiiro: the Shellaine is shaped like an akoya pearl oyster and hand-baked with no raising agents or preservatives, using Mie-grown Ayahikari wheat, Toba eggs and pearl calcium from Mikimoto Pharmaceutical. Served at the coffee break of the G7 Ise-Shima Summit; won the Honorary President's Award at the 22nd National Confectionery Exposition and the Mie award of the Japan Gift Awards 2017.

伊勢志摩観光ナビによると、錦屋は鳥羽3丁目にある「鳥羽水族館に最も近い宿＆お食事.en: According to the Ise-Shima tourism navigator, Nishikiya in Toba 3-chōme is 'the inn and restaurant closest to Toba Aquarium', serving tekone-zushi, house-made Ise udon, seafood bowls, fried shrimp and more. Tabelog also lists it as a diner / seafood / noodles, with tekone-zushi, Ise udon and seafood bowls as its specialities.

全製品に乳製品（発酵バター・生クリーム）が使用されており、ヴィーガン向け製品との.en: Every product uses dairy (cultured butter, fresh cream), and there appears to be no separate production for vegan products.

八幡屋礒五郎公式・boooon・arura・web-komachiで確認：八幡屋.en: Confirmed on the Yawataya Isogoro official site, Boooon, arura and web-komachi: run directly by Yawataya Isogoro; opened around 2014; brick building modelled on the Shinshu University Faculty of Education library; renovated in spring 2022; three curries and spice gelato from the company's own farm; a 10th-anniversary 'THANK YOU CURRY' (10 spices).

公式 about ページに店主アシシュ・シルプカー（身長191cm、2005年愛.en: The official about page states owner Ashish Shilpkar (191 cm tall, came to Japan for Expo 2005 Aichi, opened in 2016), 'the smallest North Indian home-cooking restaurant in Japan', that every curry is free of gluten, nuts, sugar and monosodium glutamate, Azumino-grown Koshihikari rice, and first place in TripAdvisor's curry category in 2018. deli-koma also confirms Ashish, Azumino Koshihikari and halal handling. The chapati is wheat.

公式 cafe-fuwafuwa.com・Web-Komachi・echohal.en: The official cafe-fuwafuwa.com, Web-Komachi and echohall.jp agree: opened 30 June 2022; owner Komiyama Atsushi; 100% rice flour; guilt-free / less sugar; selected rice flour + Nagano-grown red sorghum flour; soy-milk whipped cream; free-range eggs from hens on non-GM feed from Aida. No cross-contact protocol for celiac diners is published.

公式 nicosimply.com・atrashome・ぐるなび・食べログが、中.en: The official nicosimply.com, atrashome, Gurunavi and Tabelog describe an additive-free, organic natural-food restaurant in Yoshida, Nakano City: hemp-charcoal natural-yeast pizza and fresh pasta, a salad bar of local vegetables, no MSG, sales of CBD/hemp foods and goods, a dog-friendly terrace, vegan/vegetarian/gluten-free menus, opened 2004, about 200 drinks and live bands. The owner's name is not published. Safety for celiac diners is not guaranteed.

公式 wixsite は オーガニック・マクロビ・ヴィーガン・グルテンフリー・ア.en: The official Wix site states organic, macrobiotic, vegan, gluten-free and allergy-friendly, and that the chef travels around organic farms nationwide to buy vegetables. Vegewel says it is run by a couple, with Kuwahara Michiko (first-class dietary life adviser) as operator, serving Japanese vegan food. Tabelog also confirms organic, macrobiotic and vegan.

公式(crayonsite)・local-prime・tanosu・budou-.en: From the official site (crayonsite), local-prime, tanosu and budou-chan. The owner is a former pâtissier who developed asthma, a runny nose, hand eczema and itchy eyes from wheat, and opened a rice-flour workshop. The shop states: “We do not use wheat flour in the workshop”, “100% rice flour”, “No wheat, dairy, egg or nuts (breads)”. Moved and reopened at Tadera 8-13-52 on 28 September 2025. No source names the owner.

公式food.htmlはうなぎ湯葉を『昭和30年代に考案し、ずっと作り続けている.en: The official food.html says unagi yuba (mock eel of tofu skin) is 'a Konokonbou speciality devised in the 1950s and made ever since', that the cooking is named 'Muryoju' (Infinite Life), and that hōhan is a rice dish to finish with shojin dashi, eaten at Zenkoji's New Year 'Dōdōji' ceremony. Go! NAGANO (id20052) says serious shojin cuisine began about 50 years ago, with Konokonbou leading the way; the then head priest's wife set the course, and today 若麻績妙子 carries on the flavours.

公式tenpoページで安曇野スワンガーデン内の本店、一年中炭火の囲炉裏で購入した.en: The official tenpo page confirms the main shop in Swan Garden Azumino, the experience of grilling the oyaki you buy at a charcoal irori hearth all year round, always more than 20 kinds and over 40 a year, dough mixed with rice flour or sixteen grains, and the tenant shop inside Takahashi Shoten on Zenkoji Nakamise.

公式「北野家の歴史」ページより、明治33年に初代七郎右衛門が保科で創業、四代続く.en: From the official 'History of Kitanoya' page: founded in Meiji 33 (1900) in Hoshina by the first-generation 七郎右衛門, a long-established shop of four generations. The kaeshi has been kept in two heirloom jars for over 100 years; frigate-mackerel and small bonito flakes are shaved in-house 3–4 times a month, taking over two hours. A food blog (September 2024) confirms the texture of a limited 10-a-day 100% buckwheat soba of Togakushi buckwheat stone-milled in Shinano-machi.

公式『会社概要』に代表者『飯田紗央里』、2017年2月開業・2019年10月法人.en: The official 'company profile' states the representative, 飯田紗央里 (Iida Saori), opening in February 2017 and incorporation in October 2019. A Web-Komachi article describes the background (product development at a Tokyo café and research into vegan diets and food allergies as the starting point) and the move from Miwa, Nagano City to in front of Nagano Station (15 January 2022). Butter-sandwich flavours confirmed include seasonal fruit such as Kyoho grape. Some details, such as hometown, are unknown.

公式サイト nanakoshi.com は創業50年以上・鳥羽の名物（伊勢うどん.en: The official site nanakoshi.com says the shop has been going for over 50 years and serves Toba specialities such as Ise udon. The Ise-Shima tourism association (iseshima-kanko.jp) lists chewy, thick Ise udon, house-made udon, tekone-zushi and turban shells grilled in the shell. A personal blog (sirokuroomochi, Golden Week 2025) confirms a family business, a tamari-soy dashi sauce handed down through the generations, Ise udon boiled for about 40 minutes, and a tekone-zushi set (about ¥1,540).

公式サイト(sanyasou.co.jp)は農家のお母さんたちが地元野菜で一つ一.en: The official site (sanyasou.co.jp) says its mainstay is oyaki hand-made one by one by farming mothers with local vegetables, and that it also sells suiton, oden and amazake. Spicy radish and nozawana oyaki are confirmed. JA operation, founding year, additive-free and a direct-sales model are not stated, so those lines were removed or softened. The anecdotes of seasonal changes (jalan) and the thoughtful cold water (55anz) were confirmed in the cited sources.

The menu page confirms a seafood bowl at ¥2,650 (salted salmon and an original sauce under the rice), a sashimi set (8 kinds of seasonal sashimi, the house best) and a wild kuruma prawn fry set.

公式サイトで瀬下努(1977年長野県生)・東京の調理師学校後オテル・ドゥ・ミクニ.en: The official site confirms Tsutomu Seshimo (born 1977 in Nagano Prefecture); after cooking school in Tokyo, 12 years at Hôtel de Mikuni; head chef in Izu and at Sankara in Yakushima; opened December 2016; the name means 'encounter'. Hitosara confirms a renovated 150-year-old house, 18 seats, and a garden of home-grown herbs and flowers.

公式サイトとぐるなび・gorpで確認：浜の味処 天びん屋グループ(本店・一番街店.en: Confirmed on the official site, Gurunavi and gorp: the Hama no Ajidokoro Tenbinya group (main shop, Ichiban-gai shop, Amiyaki); the ama diver's kamameshi is a certified Toba local bento; a seafood bowl of six kinds plus sea urchin and salmon roe; Ise udon and tekone-zushi.

公式サイトとブログ・検索で確認：2013年12月30日創業、1階物販＋2階カフェ.en: Confirmed on the official site, blogs and searches: founded 30 December 2013; shop on the first floor and café on the second; house-roasted coffee, seafood curry and house-made waffles. Corrected: what architect 藤原徹平 designed is Hinoyama Lab (the Senkiraku project), opened in 2023, not the second floor of the main shop.

公式サイトとメニューで確認：鳥羽一番街3階・駅隣接、伊勢うどん、鳥羽産しらす釜玉.en: Confirmed on the official site and menu: third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, next to the station; Ise udon, Toba whitebait kamatama udon, large shrimp tempura, oysters and fresh aosa (winter), sudachi (summer), akamoku seaweed, Matsusaka beef. Corrected あおさ to aosa.

公式サイトと伊勢志摩観光ナビで確認：昭和51年(1976)創業、鳥羽駅隣接の鳥羽.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Ise-Shima tourism navigator: founded 1976 (Shōwa 51); a classic coffee shop inside Toba Ichiban-gai next to Toba Station; famous for the Tobager (octopus, mayo and nut topping, about ¥780), local pasta and curry.

公式サイトと現地レポートによれば、ミネルヴァは鳥羽駅前・鳥羽一番街1階のジェラー.en: According to the official site and on-site reports, Minerva is a gelato shop on the first floor of Toba Ichiban-gai in front of Toba Station, with the slogan 'Delivered fresh from the factory' (made in Futami, Ise City). It uses milk from Okoppe, Hokkaido, and its signature is the Pearl Latte (milk gelato with pearl powder, said to be good for the skin). It has Ise-Shima local flavours such as Iwato salt, Ise tea and kinko sweet potato.

公式サイトと鳥羽市観光協会で確認：名物ガンガン焼き(浦村産牡蠣・通年提供・2〜3.en: Confirmed on the official site and the Toba tourism association: the signature gangan-yaki (Uramura oysters, served all year, flash-frozen at −60 °C in February–March), Ise chicken, finest Matsusaka beef and a special miso sauce. Grade A4 is not in the sources, so changed to 'finest'.

公式サイトに全品目のアレルゲン一覧ページが整備されており、原材料を事前に確認でき.en: The official site has an allergen list page for every product, so you can check the ingredients beforehand.

公式サイト・Jalan・Tabelog が、約140年の歴史をもつ湯田中温泉の源.en: The official site, Jalan and Tabelog confirm a ryokan with about 140 years of history in Yudanaka Onsen, with free-flowing hot-spring water (4 sources, 2 open-air baths), serving local kaiseki by the head chef. No gluten-free handling is published; only individual consultation in advance.

公式サイト・ブログで確認：2017年7月開店、昭和通りの元家具店を改装、シェフは.en: Confirmed on the official site and blogs: opened July 2017 in a converted former furniture shop on Shōwa-dōri; the chef trained in Canada and New York, then worked at a Nagano hotel; house-made focaccia of soy milk and mixed grains; game (venison, boar); deli plates; a sign saying 'babies' crying welcome'.

公式サイト等によると、鳥羽志摩農協（JA）と鳥羽磯部漁協（JF）が共同設立した鳥.en: According to the official site and others, a farm-and-sea direct market, rare even nationally, run by the Toba Marche LLP, set up jointly by the Toba-Shima agricultural co-op (JA) and the Toba-Isobe fisheries co-op (JF). About 2 minutes' walk from Toba Station. A direct-sales shop of about 310 m² and a local-produce restaurant under one roof. From 1 February 2025 it switched from an all-you-can-eat buffet to 'Toba meshi' of local ingredients (local-fish sashimi, one plate per person; tekone-zushi; local-fish carpaccio; kakiage, etc.). Red Pearl strawberry soft serve is its speciality.

公式サイト（about）は2021年6月22日開業、ミシュランシェフとのタイアッ.en: The official site (about) confirms the opening on 22 June 2021, "Zeimi" from a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, and domestic real bracken starch. A round-up article records the TV appearance and the expansion to 12 shops nationwide.

公式サイト（jimdo）は1998年創業、西二階町、目の前で揚げて素早く提供する.en: The official site (jimdo) records: founded 1998; Nishi-Nikaimachi; a policy of frying in front of you and serving quickly; a kushikatsu set lunch. The ma8coro blog tells the story that the name comes from an Osaka shop called Moguraya (a favourite of the previous owner's partner), mentions rabbit-pattern plates, and a ¥800 lunch of 7 skewers. Tabelog confirms it as a kushiage shop in Nishi-Nikaimachi.

公式サイト（owst）で、南町の立地、伝助穴子（漁獲の数％の希少穴子）を刺身・焼.en: The official site (owst) confirms: the Minami-cho location; Densuke conger eel (a rare eel, a few percent of the catch) served as sashimi, grilled and as hitsumabushi; Himeji lotus root and Himeji oden; local sake such as Tatsuriki and Yaegaki; a modern Japanese interior described as "another world".

公式サイト：明治8年（1875）創業、お茶一筋約150年、二階町66、喫茶「存外.en: Official site: founded in 1875 (Meiji 8); about 150 years devoted to tea; Nikaimachi 66; the café "Zongai"; the green soft serve, loved for over 50 years. KissPress: matcha and wagashi set ¥500 (tax included); daily wagashi from local confectioners (Kineya and others); the green soft serve was developed jointly by several tea shops; choose your favourite tea bowl from around Japan. visit-himeji: choose a bowl and enjoy freshly whisked tea casually at table seats. The number of seats is not stated, so it is not given.

Opened around 2011.

公式会社概要（2001年5月設立・代表向井昭博・2004年ネット通販・2011年.en: Confirmed by the official company profile (founded May 2001; representative 向井昭博; online sales from 2004; Himeji Castle shop March 2011; a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure; Harima-nada) and searches (Harima White Pearl = virgin oysters that have never spawned, farmed at Ieshima, with little harshness or bitterness). The MAFF Kinki Regional Agricultural Administration Office inbound case-study URL is official but now returns 403, so its text could not be re-fetched.

公式（machishin）はまちづくり振興機構運営、大手門駐車場内・本町68、喫.en: The official site (machishin) confirms: run by the Urban Development Promotion Organization; inside the Otemon car park, Honmachi 68; café (coffee, cappuccino, etc.); a Yamazaki convenience corner; free wheelchair loans; Himeji Castle goods. The Himeji tourism site lists almond toast ¥458 and rice-koji amazake ¥356.

公式（owst）：兵庫県姫路市立町71、播磨うまいもん居酒屋、穴子（焼き1,08.en: Official site (owst): Tatemachi 71, Himeji, Hyogo; an izakaya of Harima local food; conger eel (grilled ¥1,080 / tempura ¥880 / chazuke ¥690); Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce); the homemade shrimp shumai (¥470) is popular. Tabelog: sourced from Murotsu and Boze ports and contract farmers; 20 seats. ma8coro: the chef-owner recommends the shumai. ameblo: covered in celebrity autographs.

公益社団法人姫路市まちづくり振興機構.en: Himeji City Urban Development Promotion Organization

兵庫県姫路市（姫路駅前地下街グランフェスタ6番街）.en: Himeji, Hyogo (Gran Festa 6-ban-gai, the underground mall in front of Himeji Station)

内容により小麦・卵・乳を含む場合あり。セットのケーキは大麦粉。要相談。.en: May contain wheat, egg or dairy depending on the contents. The set's cake is barley flour. Ask.

冬:さつまいも/春:抹茶等。卵・乳の有無を要確認。.en: Winter: sweet potato; spring: matcha, etc. Check for egg and dairy.

初春〜春・店頭販売のみ.en: early spring to spring, sold in store only

初秋〜春・実演販売のみ.en: early autumn to spring, made and sold in front of you only

券売機で食券を購入する日本式の食堂スタイル。英語メニューや英語スタッフの情報はな.en: A Japanese-style diner where you buy a meal ticket from a machine. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff; provision for overseas visitors is probably limited.

刺身そのものは基本的に無添加・小麦不使用で提供されることが多く、醤油を避ければ選.en: Sashimi itself is often served with no additives or wheat, so there may be items you can choose if you avoid the soy sauce.

刺身・牛肉・焼き魚・海老天ぷらなど動物性食材を同一厨房で扱うため、植物性料理との.en: Sashimi, beef, grilled fish and shrimp tempura are handled in the same kitchen, so plant dishes risk contact. No mention of dedicated vegan cooking equipment.

創業82年で姫路の老舗として行列ができる店と紹介され、過去4店舗から現在1店舗に.en: Introduced as an 82-year-old Himeji institution with queues, and the story of consolidating from four shops to one is recorded.

創業82年以上の姫路の老舗とんかつ店。店名「赤心」は、創業者の曽祖父が敬慕した勝.en: A long-established Himeji tonkatsu shop, over 82 years old. The name "Sekishin" is said to come from words of Katsu Kaishu, whom the founder's great-grandfather admired, and means "a sincere heart". It once had four shops in Himeji but now runs only the main shop. It has appeared on TV and in other media several times.

創業明治初年.en: founded in the first year of Meiji (about 1868)

創業明治初年より鳥羽港にて、すし販売を続けております。地産地消をめざし、煮付けは.en: Since our founding in the first year of Meiji we have sold sushi at Toba Port. We aim for local production for local consumption, and our simmered dishes are house-made.

動物性不使用・8大アレルゲンフリー・米粉。.en: No animal products, free of the 8 major allergens, rice flour.

十割なのにのど越しがすごくよく、ボソボソ感もなく、かなりな技術で打たれている.en: Even though it's 100% buckwheat it goes down wonderfully smoothly, with no crumbliness: made with real skill

卵・乳・白砂糖不使用、グルテンフリー.en: no egg, dairy or white sugar; gluten-free

卵・乳製品・小麦を持ち込まない.en: no egg, dairy or wheat brought in

厚さ5cmを超えるニューヨークスタイルの極厚スコーン。 定番のプレーンスコーンは.en: Extra-thick New York-style scones over 5 cm tall. The standard plain scone, a best-seller, puts the aroma and flavour of Yotsuba cultured butter up front ("Buttery Plain Scone", ¥300). About 20 kinds of scone change daily.

参道沿いの観光地にあり指さし注文は可能だが、メニュー・スタッフ対応は日本語のみ。.en: On a tourist street along the temple approach; pointing to order works, but the menu and staff are Japanese only.

古民家の趣を活かした猫モチーフのインテリアと温かい照明が「おばあちゃんの家」のよ.en: Several bloggers say the cat-themed interior and warm lighting, set off by the old house, feel nostalgic, 'like grandma's house'.

味付けは基本的に店主さんお任せ.en: the seasoning is basically left to the owner

和菓子 (Wagashi) · 節句限定・店頭販売のみ.en: Wagashi · for seasonal festivals only, sold in store only

和食・おばんざいの調理では一般的な醤油（小麦含有）が使用されると考えられる。グル.en: Japanese and obanzai cooking presumably uses ordinary soy sauce (contains wheat). No explicit use of gluten-free soy sauce.

善光寺の本坊・大勧進の紫雲閣内に設けられた寺院カフェ。2024年12月より、小布.en: A temple café inside the Shiunkaku hall of Daikanjin, the head lodging of Zenkoji. Since December 2024 it has been run by Izutsuya Tetsuji, a sweets brand devoted to Obuse chestnuts and Shinshu fruit, as the brand's first café.

善光寺の西側、湯福神社に隣接する昭和30年代築（築60〜70年ほど）の古民家を改.en: A hideaway café in a renovated old house built in the 1950s–60s (60–70 years old), next to Yubuku Shrine on the west side of Zenkoji, in Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City. You take off your shoes and change into slippers to go in.

善光寺下駅周辺・門前町.en: around Zenkoji-shita Station · the temple town

善光寺公式・hotpepper・rurubu・善光寺御朱印まとめが、約1400年.en: Zenkoji's official site, Hot Pepper, Rurubu and a Zenkoji goshuin round-up back up: a permanent temple lodging of about 1,400 years; the principal image Dainichi Nyorai; renovation in the Heisei era; 39 lodgings; no meat, fish or five pungent vegetables; the head priest's pesticide-free vegetables; the grain-based 'Nagano grain set meal'; house-made sesame tofu; and a finish of Japanese sweets with matcha.

善光寺参拝後に身体を温め、心を整えるための食を提供。お朝事の終了時刻に合わせて開.en: Food to warm the body and settle the mind after visiting Zenkoji. It opens to match the end of the morning service, aiming to give a taste of shojin as the close of the visit.

四季に寄り添うわらび餅——春は花見菓子、夏は冷製、秋は茶菓子、冬は温かく。 国産.en: Warabi mochi that follows the seasons: festive sweets in spring, chilled in summer, tea sweets in autumn, warm in winter. Particular about domestic real bracken starch, aiming for its own springiness and a mellow, melting texture.

四季の信州食材を用いた山楼海鮮懐石.en: Seasonal kaiseki of mountain and sea, with Shinshu ingredients of the four seasons

四季折々の山の幸・川の幸にこだわった郷土会席料理」.en: local kaiseki devoted to each season's bounty of the mountains and rivers"

国産米粉・国産片栗粉・米油・てんさい糖・天日塩・ドライイースト・オオバコ.en: domestic rice flour, domestic potato starch, rice-bran oil, beet sugar, sun-dried salt, dry yeast, psyllium

国産米粉・片栗粉・米油・てんさい糖・天日塩・イースト・オオバコ.en: Domestic rice flour, potato starch, rice-bran oil, beet sugar, sun-dried salt, yeast, psyllium

地元の活〆穴子.en: local conger eel, killed by ikejime

地産地消・旬の食材.en: local produce eaten locally, seasonal ingredients

基本的に小麦の麺と一緒に茹でる.en: basically boiled together with the wheat noodles

変わらない味を守ること。 昭和の雰囲気を残したまま、素朴で飾らない大衆中華を提供.en: Keeping an unchanging flavour. Continuing to serve simple, unpretentious Chinese food in a Showa-era atmosphere.

外見、瀕死じゃないですか.en: Doesn't it look half-dead from the outside?

大名つづら（10種以上の季節料理＋抹茶フォンデュのセット御膳）および抹茶フォンデ.en: Daimyo Tsuzura (a set meal of 10+ seasonal dishes plus matcha fondue) and matcha fondue

大善公式サイトはつなぎなしの十割そば、信濃町黒姫山の霧下そば使用、テレビ東京『い.en: The Daizen official site says it serves 100% buckwheat soba with no binder, uses kirishita (mist-grown) buckwheat from Mt. Kurohime in Shinano-machi, and was featured on TV Tokyo's 'Ii Tabi Yume Kibun' (4 October 2006). food.onarimon says its kaeshi is made by its own method with naturally brewed tamari soy sauce containing no wheat, and aged three months in earthenware jars. The samcamp blog says 'it seems to be run by a young owner', praises 'the new-power spirit of Shinshu soba', and commends the 100% buckwheat technique.

大手回転寿司チェーンでタッチパネル注文が中心のため英語メニューや操作で言葉に頼ら.en: A major conveyor-belt sushi chain with touch-panel ordering, so you can order without relying on English menus or speech; but allergy questions need a word with the staff, and some Japanese helps.

大町市大町・文化会館サン・アルプス大町棟内.en: Omachi, Omachi City · inside the Sun Alps Omachi Cultural Hall

天ぷら・揚げ物を含む懐石コースで専用フライヤーの有無は不明。グルテン交差汚染リス.en: Kaiseki courses include tempura and fried dishes; whether there is a dedicated fryer is unknown. Nothing has been published about gluten cross-contamination risk.

天ぷら・油物メニューあり（「塩のみで」との記述はあるが専用フライヤーの使用有無は.en: There are tempura and fried items (one note says "with salt only", but whether a dedicated fryer is used is unconfirmed). It may share a kitchen and fryer with wheat-containing fried foods.

失敗を恐れないチャレンジ精神.en: a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure

姫路の名物・穴子（アナゴ）を使った穴子丼。天ぷらや揚げ物、丼ものも提供する。.en: Conger-eel bowls using anago, a Himeji specialty. Also tempura, fried dishes and rice bowls.

姫路の地酒と姫路おでん本舗.en: Himeji no Jizake to Himeji Oden Honpo

姫路まちづくり振興機構の公式ページと好古園資料で、好古園は1992年開園・総面積.en: The Himeji City Urban Development Promotion Organization's official page and Koko-en materials confirm: Koko-en opened in 1992, covers 3.5 ha and was laid out on the site of the west residences; Kassui-ken is the garden's restaurant, serving conger eel dishes, the Hime set meal and more.

姫路みたい特集・神戸新聞(Yahoo!転載)・BASE通販より。NPO法人姫路こ.en: From a Himeji Mitai feature, the Kobe Shimbun (via Yahoo!) and BASE online shop. A Type-B continuing-employment support farm (Yamada-cho Makino 619-1) run by the NPO Himeji Kokoro social-welfare organization. Sells gluten-free "Poritto" snacks made from naturally grown rice flour (bronze at the 2022 Habatake contest) and dried rice-flour noodles directly and online. Holds a Hatake Café once a month.

姫路れんこん饅頭かにあんかけ.en: Himeji lotus-root dumpling with thick crab sauce

姫路地区手をつなぐ育成会.en: Himeji District 'Hand in Hand' support association

姫路城〜姫路駅 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Himeji Castle to Himeji Station · vegetarian and gluten-free

姫路城下町という歴史的な街並みの中に、ブラックを基調とした都会的な外観とオレンジ.en: In the historic castle-town streets, the urban black exterior and orange neon tubes stand out, and passers-by drawn in by the sweet smell of baking have become a familiar sight.

姫路市亀井町、瀬戸内海の恵みを活かした海鮮料理店.en: Kameimachi, Himeji: a seafood restaurant making the most of the Seto Inland Sea

姫路市十二所前町、播磨灘産穴子を専門とする.en: Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji; specialises in Harima-nada conger eel

姫路市本町68 家老屋敷B棟.en: Honmachi 68, Himeji; chief-retainer residence building B

姫路市本町（姫路城前）.en: Honmachi, Himeji (in front of Himeji Castle)

姫路店の「朝フレンチマン」（平日午前・10:00〜、¥770）はホットサンド＋サ.en: The Himeji shop's "Morning Frenchman" (weekday mornings from 10:00, ¥770) comes with a hot sandwich, salad and a drink. It drew attention as a morning menu unique to the Himeji shop, timed to the building's opening hours.

姫路経済新聞(3周年記事)・TANOSU取材・公式サイトより。店主貝塚暁子さんが.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun (3rd-anniversary article), a TANOSU feature and the official site. The owner, 貝塚暁子, opened in 2019 (3rd anniversary on 8 August 2022). "Organic junkie" with homemade koji seasonings and organic ingredients. Wheat flour and sugar avoided as far as possible; sweets use barley flour and are gluten-free; the pound cake is 100% Kyushu barley flour.

姫路経済新聞・Kiss PRESS・Food Diversity・公式サイトより.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun, Kiss PRESS, Food Diversity and the official site. A former izakaya owner opened on 21 March 2023 in Shirakuni-kitashinmachi. A fully vegan restaurant supervised by Tokyo's Saido. The signature "sai-men" are colourful noodles made from vegetables. Sweets are made by Ibuki of Okayama, free of animal ingredients and the 8 major allergens. The name comes from 菜 (vegetables), sai-men, Saido and sai (rhinoceros) (official).

姫路経済新聞・budou-chan: オーナー見満みなみは2012年に製菓学校卒.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun and budou-chan: the owner, 見満みなみ, graduated from confectionery school in 2012, studied pastry and cooking in Germany and France for about 8 years, and on 1 October 2025 opened "Miinas", a gluten-free organic café, at Shikisai 638-1, Himeji (right by JR Yobe Station, Aoyama-kita Bldg). About 31 tsubo, 6 tables, 16 seats; everything available to take away. Serves bagels and burgers of 100% domestic organic rice flour. A pet-grooming salon (深山梨江) is attached, separated by a wall.

姫路経済新聞・tanosuで、2025年11月28日開業、店長 菅原早穂子、自家.en: The Himeji Keizai Shimbun and tanosu confirm: opened 28 November 2025; the manager; house-roasted, house-ground almond butter (Classic/Crunch); almond-milk soup; butter chicken curry with 18 spices, almond butter and almond dukkah.

姫路経済新聞：料理長・大庭拓哉（和食歴30年）、店長・松岡加奈子、2025年11.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun: head chef 大庭拓哉 (30 years in Japanese cuisine); manager 松岡加奈子; opened 27 November 2025; in the Gran Festa basement; fish from the ports of Murotsu, Boze and Shikama; whole sea bream tempura, Himeji oden, live conger eel. KissPress: the name comes from the owner's surname, written in hiragana. Himeji Festa official site: Gran Festa 5-ban-gai, opened 27 November.

姫路駅直結の地下街グランフェスタ内にあり、雨の日でも濡れずにアクセスできる利便性.en: Inside Gran Festa, the underground mall connected to Himeji Station, so you can get there without getting wet on rainy days; popular with business people and travellers for the convenience.

季節のプリンは卵・乳を含む可能性。ぽりっと・米粉麺は植物性。.en: The seasonal pudding may contain egg and dairy. Poritto and the rice-flour noodles are plant-based.

安くてうまい、気軽に立ち寄れる街の中華立ち飲み屋として地元に根付いてきた。.en: Rooted locally as a cheap, tasty neighbourhood Chinese stand-up bar you can drop into easily.

安曇野のジャズファンブログが、店主自作管理のJBLランサーからジャズが流れ、オー.en: An Azumino jazz fan's blog backs up an owner who plays jazz through JBL Lancer speakers the owner built and maintains, and who talks about audio and the history of Zenkoji. ekiten and Retty back up hand-made soba (Nagano buckwheat) along Nakamise and entrances on two sides.

安曇野市に本拠を置く信州の郷土食専門店。 長野・善光寺の仲見世通り（参道）に漬物.en: A Shinshu local-food specialist based in Azumino City. It has a tenant shop on Zenkoji's Nakamise-dori (the temple approach) inside the long-established pickle shop Takahashi Shoten. The main shop is in Swan Garden Azumino, famous for letting you grill the oyaki you buy at an irori hearth where a charcoal fire burns all year.

完全ヴィーガン。動物性原材料・乳製品・精製糖・うまみ調味料・アルコール調味料は不.en: Fully vegan. No animal ingredients, dairy, refined sugar, MSG or alcohol seasonings.

完全予約制で少人数制のため、事前に食の制限を伝える余地がある。オーナーが素材を個.en: Reservation-only with small numbers, so there is room to explain dietary restrictions in advance. A small independent shop where the owner picks ingredients individually, so it may be flexible.

完全予約制の懐石料理店。英語メニューあり（訪日外国人向け対応）。靴を脱いで入店す.en: A reservation-only kaiseki restaurant. English menu available (for overseas visitors). Tatami rooms where you take your shoes off. Cards accepted and set up for overseas guests, but communication is mainly in Japanese.

官公式サイト(mu-sea.com)と伊勢志摩観光ナビ、食べログで確認：2013.en: Confirmed on the official site (mu-sea.com), the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabelog: founded December 2013; the Toba Station branch opened on 7 March 2021; house-roasted coffee and spice-curry bread; a seaside roastery.

家族経営（創業者一族が各店舗を分担）.en: Family business (the founding family shares the running of the branches)

家老屋敷跡.en: site of a chief retainer's residence

寺粥御膳は根菜の煮物や豆腐など植物性食材を中心とした構成と複数のレビューが報告し.en: Several reviews report that the temple porridge set is built mostly from plant ingredients such as simmered root vegetables and tofu.

寺粥御膳（¥1,500）—精進のお粥に根菜や豆腐料理などが添えられるセット。小布.en: The temple rice-porridge set (¥1,500): shojin porridge with root vegetables, tofu dishes and more. Obuse-chestnut kuri-tsuzuri (Mont Blanc), seasonal Japanese sweets and oshiruko are also popular.

寺院：善光寺大勧進（天台宗本坊）.en: Temple: Zenkoji Daikanjin (the Tendai head lodging)

小さなカウンター中心の小料理屋。英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報なし。日本語.en: A small counter-centred koryori restaurant. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff. Communication is basically in Japanese.

小さな地元向け割烹居酒屋で、英語メニューや外国語対応の記載は一切なく、日本語のみ.en: A small local kappo izakaya with no mention of an English menu or other languages; Japanese only.

小さな町のなかのレストラン.en: a restaurant in a small town

小川真宏氏は約30年にわたり淵之坊の厨房を取り仕切り、善光寺の祭礼食をベースにし.en: 小川真宏 (Ogawa Masahiro) has run the Fuchinobo kitchen for about 30 years, creating seasonal menus based on Zenkoji's festival food.

小町記事(261229)で文政10年(1827)創業・八代目藤澤浩一が銀行員を経.en: A Komachi article (261229) confirms: founded in Bunsei 10 (1827); eighth-generation 藤澤浩一 took over in 1999 after working as a banker; trained under 片倉康雄 of Isshoan; kirishita buckwheat grown by 石川浩幸 in Shinano-machi; a 91% blend. The official site (fujikian.co.jp/en) states it was founded in 1827, in the time of the 11th shogun Tokugawa Ienari, is a soba shop of eight generations, and uses Kurohime kirishita buckwheat (no mention of katsudon). Saijiki confirms three dipping sauces (dashi, walnut, grated yam).

小規模な古民家カフェで英語メニューや英語対応の記録はなく、日本語のみの環境と思わ.en: A small old-house café with no record of an English menu or English service; probably a Japanese-only setting.

小規模な就労施設の製造・直売所。米粉製品専用ラインか小麦と共用かは未確認。要確認.en: A small welfare-workplace production site and farm shop. Whether there is a dedicated rice-flour line or it is shared with wheat is unconfirmed. To be confirmed.

小豆餡、小麦粉、砂糖、大豆油、そば粉、酵母、食塩.en: red-bean paste, wheat flour, sugar, soybean oil, buckwheat flour, yeast, salt

小麦の可能性。要確認。.en: May contain wheat. To be confirmed.

小麦を一切扱わない完全グルテンフリー＆ヴィーガンの菓子工房で、全商品が対象。添加.en: A fully gluten-free and vegan sweets workshop that handles no wheat at all, covering every product. Additives too are 'avoided as far as we can'.

小麦・そば・卵・乳・落花生・えび・かに・くるみ.en: wheat, buckwheat, egg, milk, peanut, shrimp, crab, walnut

小麦・乳・卵不使用、有機豆乳使用.en: no wheat, milk or egg; organic soy milk

旧旅館の客間をリノベーションした靴脱ぎ式のレンタルスペースは、赤ちゃん連れでも安.en: The rental space, a renovated guest room of the old inn where you take off your shoes, is loved locally as a family space that's comfortable even with a baby, and is used for concerts, exhibitions and more.

The official menu confirms the large fried shrimp set meal is limited to 20 a day.

The restaurant has 'ama hut seats' recreating an ama diver's hut, and charcoal hearth-grilled live Ise lobster and live abalone are the speciality (the charcoal course is currently suspended). The most popular dish is the 'tekone-zushi set', a local dish of the Shima area (soy-marinated bonito on vinegared rice); the generous seafood bowl, Ise lobster and abalone sashimi set, and big fried shrimp are also well reviewed. There's a fish tank at the entrance, stump-style tables and tatami seating; in winter grilled turban shell gives way to grilled oysters.

The signature "Warabi Mochi Zeimi", created in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, is known for its jiggly, melting texture and rich kinako flavour. It has since expanded through franchising to 12 shops nationwide.

Squid-ink risotto, fresh pasta, wood-fired pizza, carpaccio, sautéed white asparagus, prosciutto and melon, etc. The homemade basil butter and baguette are well liked. 食べログ・ぐるなび・鳥羽観光協会等によると、鳥羽駅南口から徒歩約4分の海鮮食堂。.en: According to Tabelog, Gurunavi and the Toba tourism association, a seafood diner about 4 minutes' walk from the south exit of Toba Station. Shellfish and Ise lobster bought that day swim in the tank, and every set meal (about ¥1,500–1,650) comes with Ise lobster miso soup (with half a lobster). The fried shrimp set and the all-shellfish set are popular. The owner and the owner's wife are praised for a warm welcome and the homey atmosphere. Closed Thursdays.

食べログ・エキテンのレビューが、特選刺身盛り合わせ・踊り活けタコ・鯛かぶと焼き・.en: Tabelog and Ekiten reviews confirm: the special sashimi platter, live octopus, grilled sea bream head and eel with egg, sashimi described as "best in Himeji", and a hideaway location with no lit sign. The owner's name is not public. The TripAdvisor original now returns 403 and could not be rechecked.

食べログ・ヒトサラで住所（本町68-4）と2023年4月24日開店、暗めでおしゃ.en: Tabelog and Hitosara confirm the address (Honmachi 68-4), the opening on 24 April 2023, and a dim, stylish izakaya. goguynet and ameblo confirm one owner running the counter alone and a "festival bar" vibe; rrmat288 confirms nostalgic Japanese punk and new-wave music; ma8coro confirms a three-item chef's-choice plate and Koeigiku Anastasia Green sake.

食べログ・ホットペッパーが、2025年11月16日大手前通り沿い（本町68）開業.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper confirm: opened 16 November 2025 on Otemae-dori (Honmachi 68); café by day, izakaya by night; French technique with fresh fish and selected meat; rare salmon cutlet, seared wagyu, sea bream meunière. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・ホットペッパーの店舗情報とレビューで、2026年2月11日開業、久保町.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper shop information and reviews confirm: opened 11 February 2026; a hideaway Japanese kappo for grown-ups in Kubo-cho; serves Himeji Densuke conger eel, salt-grilled sweetfish and domestic beef; about 17 seats. The signature is conger eel (anago), not pike conger (hamo).

食べログ（穴子・鰻の割烹会席、カウンター9席を含む全31席、大将の丁寧な仕込み、.en: Confirmed by Tabelog (kappo set courses of conger eel and eel; 31 seats including 9 at the counter; careful preparation by the chef-owner; seasonal cooking) and Ekiten (a kappo in Shiocho; excellent seasonal dishes; conger eel and shrimp tempura; off-menu requests considered). The owner's name is not public.

食べログ：兵庫県姫路市本町68 家老屋敷跡 ろの屋敷、姫路城前、くずもち・抹茶わ.en: Tabelog: Honmachi 68, Himeji, Hyogo, "Ro" residence in the former chief-retainer residences, in front of Himeji Castle; kuzu mochi, matcha warabi mochi, Tanba black-bean kuzu, shaved ice, dango; a sweets tea room with no reservations. Reviews praise the bouncy kuzu mochi and refined sweetness. Kuzu manju, the matcha set and others are unconfirmed, so the description was narrowed.

食を通して笑顔になってほしい.en: we want people to smile through food

食塩、粉末醤油、砂糖、節粉末（かつお、さば）、昆布粉末.en: salt, powdered soy sauce, sugar, dried-fish powder (bonito, mackerel), kombu powder
