香りや打ちたてにこだわって.en: particular about aroma and freshly made noodles

香川県丸亀市。骨付鳥は1953年（昭和28年）、丸亀の居酒屋「一鶴」の創業者・近.en: Marugame, Kagawa. Honetsuki-dori (bone-in chicken) is said to have been created in 1953 (Showa 28) by the founders of the Marugame izakaya Ikkaku, inspired by a roast-chicken scene in a Hollywood film.

駅前の観光向け産直市場併設食堂で来訪者に慣れているが、英語メニューやアレルギー個.en: A diner attached to a tourist-facing farmers' market in front of the station, used to visitors, but don't expect an English menu or individual allergy handling. If you have dietary restrictions, check ahead in Japanese, or a guide or pointing helps.

骨付ひね肉もも焼き.r: ほねつきひねにくももやき

骨付鳥「釜焼き」。 親鶏（180日以上の成鶏）と若鶏（60日未満）の2種を提供。.en: Kama-yaki bone-in chicken. Two kinds: mature hen (over 180 days) and young chicken (under 60 days). Seasoning, based on salt and pepper, is measured to the milligram to keep the taste the same in every shop. Slowly roasted in a dedicated oven (kama-yaki).

高級地鶏などの銘柄鶏にはあえてこだわらず、各地域で入手できる鶏を使うことで地域ご.en: Deliberately avoids premium branded chickens and uses birds available in each region, valuing each region's take. Buying up branded chickens would "leave none for the local shops working hard there", so the policy is not to take resources away from producing areas. Each shop serves "Sanuki Cloudy", a special cloudy sake made with three times the usual white koji, as a pairing.

高級懐石コース専門店でメニューは日本語中心。スタッフは英語対応の記載なし。外国人.en: A high-end kaiseki course restaurant with a mostly Japanese menu. No mention of English-speaking staff. Menu customisation for overseas guests (e.g. a Kobe beef course) is possible on request, with advance notice.

魚介（穴子・白魚）を中心とするメニュー構成で、動物性食材を使わない料理の選択肢は.en: The menu centres on seafood (conger eel, whitebait), with no dishes free of animal ingredients. The miso soup dashi is presumably animal-based too.

鰹節・魚介だしを使用した伝統的な日本料理店。植物性への配慮・切り替えに関する記録.en: A traditional Japanese restaurant using bonito flakes and seafood dashi. No record of any plant-based accommodation or substitution.

鳥羽商工会議所の会員検索サイトが、みしお(鳥羽1-5-8)を令和元年新規オープン.en: The Toba Chamber of Commerce member search lists Mishio (Toba 1-5-8) as an izakaya newly opened in 2019 (Reiwa 1) and carries its opening greeting. Hitosara confirms an izakaya at ¥3,000–3,999 in the evening. The specific menu was not confirmed, so it was generalised.

鳥羽商工会議所サイト・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・ブログで確認：駅徒歩5分の寿司割烹、店名.en: Confirmed on the Toba Chamber of Commerce site, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and blogs: a sushi and kappo restaurant 5 minutes' walk from the station; the name comes from the owner's training in Osaka; Ise-Shima seasonal fish always in the tank (winter: oysters and Ise lobster; spring: rockfish); the famous butterflied fried shrimp (looks like fried horse mackerel, the tail tells you it's shrimp); sets with 2–3 shrimp and the Umi no Zen.

鳥羽商船高専.en: Toba National College of Maritime Technology

鳥羽国際ホテル公式のシーホース紹介ページ(オーシャンウイング1階・88席・日本百.en: Each point is confirmed on the Toba Kokusai Hotel official Sea Horse page (Ocean Wing 1F, 88 seats, resort French overlooking Toba Bay, one of Japan's hundred best views) and the dinner menu page (graded courses Voyage / Signature / Terroir / Gastronomique, a bouillabaisse course and a vegan course).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1827)が、元海女さんが貝を焼き『焼き加減が絶妙』、海.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1827) confirms that a former ama diver grills the shellfish with 'perfect timing' and will also talk about ama diving and how to eat the season's shellfish. A personal blog records eating turban shell grilled in the shell, oysters, hiogi scallops and Ise lobster (the claim that the oysters come from Matoya could not be verified, so it was generalised).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1836)がサザエストリートの焼き貝店として、さざえ・伊.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1836) confirms a grilled-shellfish shop on Sazae Street selling turban shell, Ise lobster, abalone and other shellfish, the shop's own grilled oysters, and take-home gifts. Tabelog describes the style of choosing the shellfish you like and having it grilled on the spot.

鳥羽市観光協会と公式サイトによれば、ザ・貝屋はJR鳥羽駅前「さざえストリート」（.en: According to the Toba tourism association and the official site, The Kaiya is a grilled-shellfish specialist on 'Sazae Street' in front of JR Toba Station (where about 11 grilled-shellfish shops line up). You choose Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, oysters and more from the tank and eat them grilled on the spot. The official site says the tank water has a sterilisation system so it can serve raw oysters. A small shop mostly of tables; the proprietress's service is well regarded, and hiogi scallops (appa-gai) are a speciality.

鳥羽市観光協会ページが、鳥羽駅前・地元漁師直送の伊勢えび/あわび/さざえ/大あさ.en: The Toba tourism association page states that, in front of Toba Station, it serves Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, large clams, hard clams and grilled oysters sent straight from local fishermen; that 'we are the only place around Toba Station with a large range of Mie local sake' (including Jikon); and that solo diners at the counter are welcome.

鳥羽市観光協会・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・店の屋号(寿司・鰻・活魚)で確認：創業明治初年.en: Confirmed by the Toba tourism association, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and the shop's own sign (sushi, eel, live fish): founded in the first year of Meiji, continuously at Toba Port, among the oldest in Mie Prefecture; nigiri sushi mainly of local fish, eel and live fish, local production for local consumption, house-made simmered dishes, about a 10-minute walk from the station. 'Edomae / hand rolls' are not in the sources, so corrected to nigiri sushi.

鳥羽市（鳥羽一番街・鳥羽駅前）.en: Toba City (Toba Ichiban-gai, in front of Toba Station)

鳥羽水族館公式の館内ショップページが、花さんごを大型サンゴ礁水槽に面した落ち着い.en: The Toba Aquarium official in-house shop page introduces Hanasango as a calm restaurant facing a large coral-reef tank and confirms a menu with women in mind, Mei-chan's curry (medium-hot or mild), napolitan spaghetti with octopus sausages and a walrus parfait.

鳥羽駅 + おかげ横丁 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Toba Station + Okage Yokocho · vegetarian & gluten-free

鳥羽駅直結の鳥羽一番街3階にある海鮮のお店。鳥羽湾に浮かぶ答志島（漁業・観光の島.en: A seafood restaurant on the third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, connected to Toba Station. It buys seafood from Toshijima (an island of fishing and tourism in Toba Bay) and serves it as sashimi, grilled shellfish, small fish, dried fish, simmered fish heads and more. The signature Misasa bowl is piled with eight kinds: sea bream, amberjack, tuna, squid, small fish, wakame, sweet shrimp, salmon roe and others.

鳥羽駅近くの「さざえストリート（さざえ街道）」にある、赤ちょうちんが目印の貝焼き.en: A shellfish-grill shop on 'Sazae Street' near Toba Station, marked by a red lantern. Counter and table seats, bright and lively. Tell the staff your budget and recommended dishes are prepared to match. Charcoal-grilled turban shell, plus oysters, abalone, scallops and Ise lobster, abalone and large-clam sashimi, seasonal sea urchin and more. Sake and bottled beer too. Open 8:30–17:00.

麺と出汁にこだわった本格的な蕎麦。 毎日手打ちし、大きな窓越しに蕎麦打ちの姿を通.en: Proper soba, particular about noodles and dashi. Made by hand every day; the soba-making is visible from the street through a large window, showing the care that goes into it.

麺は生姜・明日葉・クロレラの3種だがグルテンフリー表記なし=小麦麺の想定。要確認.en: Three noodles (ginger, ashitaba, chlorella), but no gluten-free labelling, so wheat noodles are assumed. To be confirmed.
